quest.summary: I buried a coin under a lantern the day the bells first rang. Which lantern, I forget. Three stones remember.

steps.clue: Maru's coin lies under one of the two lantern statues. The marked stone by the river says which. Dig there.
Maru's coin, from under the lantern the stone names.

done: My coin, home at last. Take my mother's way with tea.
Here, the key to my house. My door is open to you.
They say the broken arch shows a way after dark. I never went to look.
